hints.title: Even Number Filtering
hints.text: Filter array elements whose lowest bit is zero (x % 2 == 0).

hints.title: Bitwise Accumulation
hints.text: Aggregate matching even elements using the bitwise inclusive-or operator.

hints.title: Empty Filter Default
hints.text: Return 0 if no even numbers are present in the array.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass accumulation of bitwise OR on even numbers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check parity and accumulate bitwise OR.
